 sum(case when quantity<=0 then 1 else 0 end) nonpos, sum(case when net_amount<0 then 1 else 0 end) negnet,
 min(sale_date), max(sale_date), count(distinct etl_loaded_at) loads,

 SELECT sum(net_sales_before_returns) gross_rpt, sum(returns_net) ret_rpt, sum(net_sales) net_rpt, count(distinct store_id) stores, max(store_id) mx
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2024-11-24'),
f AS (
 SELECT sum(case when s.store_id<900 then net_amount end) store_all,
        sum(case when s.store_id<900 and not staff_purchase_flag then net_amount end) store_nostaff,
        sum(case when s.store_id<900 and channel_code='ST' then net_amount end) store_st,
        sum(case when s.store_id=900 then net_amount end) web,
        sum(case when s.store_id=999 then net_amount end) trn,

 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2024-11-24'),

SELECT * FROM r, f, rt

WITH f AS (SELECT s.store_id, sum(net_amount) gross_all, sum(case when staff_purchase_flag then 0 else net_amount end) gross_nostaff, sum(case when f.sale_date in (select calendar_date from dim_date where not is_trading_day) then net_amount else 0 end) nontrade
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2024-11-24' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) rpt_gross FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2024-11-24' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(f.store_id, r.store_id) sid, gross_all, gross_nostaff, nontrade, rpt_gross, round(rpt_gross-gross_all,2) d_all, round(rpt_gross-gross_nostaff,2) d_nostaff
FROM f FULL JOIN r ON f.store_id=r.store_id ORDER BY abs(coalesce(rpt_gross,0)-coalesce(gross_all,0)) DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT w.status, count(*) lines, sum(f.net_amount) net,
 sum(case when f.sale_date between '2024-10-28' and '2024-11-24' then f.net_amount end) p7_net,
 sum(case when cast(f.sale_ts_utc as date) <> f.sale_date then 1 else 0 end) date_mismatch,
 sum(case when w.web_order_id is null then 1 else 0 end) noorder

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(f.net_amount) sales_net,
         sum(case when p.subcategory='Outdoor Lighting' then f.net_amount else 0 end) outdoor_lighting_part
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 AND p.category='Garden' AND s.store_id<>999
  GROUP BY 1,2),
rets AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(r.refund_net) refunds_net,
         sum(case when p.subcategory='Outdoor Lighting' then r.refund_net else 0 end) ol_ref
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 AND p.category='Garden' AND s.store_id<>999
  GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT s.fiscal_year, s.fiscal_period, s.sales_net, coalesce(r.refunds_net,0) refunds_net, s.sales_net-coalesce(r.refunds_net,0) garden_net_sales, s.outdoor_lighting_part, r.ol_ref
FROM sales s LEFT JOIN rets r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_period) ORDER BY 2

SELECT count(*) n, count(distinct return_line_id) d_id, count(distinct sales_line_id) d_sl,
 sum(case when f.sales_line_id is null then 1 else 0 end) orphan,
 sum(case when r.return_date < f.sale_date then 1 else 0 end) before_sale,
 sum(case when r.refund_net > f.net_amount + 0.01 then 1 else 0 end) over_refund,
 sum(case when r.product_key<>f.product_key then 1 else 0 end) prodkey_diff,
 sum(case when r.quantity_returned > f.quantity then 1 else 0 end) qty_over
FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id)
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-04-27'
